description: Land Acquisition - Land Compensation of Dekatana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the statutory compensation deposit for acquired land, including specific property details (village name, plan number, lot number, land name, extent), compensation amounts, and court deposit information. The content focuses solely on land/property administrative procedures without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
